## About
Hollywood Transmission is a shop that works only on transmissions. We have been at the same location on N Vermont Ave in Los Angeles for a long time, and our president, Charlie Choi, leads the team.
We work on front wheel drive and rear wheel drive cars and trucks, all wheel drive vehicles, plus vans and buses. Before any work is done, we look at your transmission and give you an estimate so you know where you stand.
We hold a 4.2 rating on Google from 58 reviews. If someone sent you our way, thank you. We consider a referral the highest compliment.

## Services
- Transmission repair and rebuilds: We repair or rebuild your old transmission, replacing damaged parts along with new soft components like rubber, plastic and clutches before reinstalling it.
- Free diagnose of your car: We look your car over at no charge. Catching a problem early can mean fewer damaged parts.
- Free estimate: You get an accurate estimate before we touch your car, so you are not stuck with a dismantled car and no choice.
- Free towing: We tow your car free for up to 15 miles when you repair your transmission with us.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on CVT and newer transmissions?
A: Yes. We have repaired and rebuilt everything from CVT transmissions to the latest 8 speed transmissions.

Q: Do you offer wholesale deals for other shops?
A: Yes. Contact one of our service managers or email info@hollywoodtrans.com. We need a copy of your automotive business license and your resellers permit.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We are open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
